name: 执行层-项目执行详情 (实例)
description: 项目执行监控钻取页面，展示关键任务节点、资源负载及延期项目排行。

sqlConfig.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(due_cnt)+SUM(outside_completed_cnt))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(completed_total_cnt)::numeric/(SUM(due_cnt)+SUM(outside_completed_cnt))::numeric*100,2) END AS "完成率", CASE WHEN (SUM(incomplete_milestone_cnt)+SUM(milestone_on_time_cnt)+SUM(milestone_overdue_completed_cnt))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(milestone_on_time_cnt)+SUM(milestone_overdue_completed_cnt))::numeric/(SUM(incomplete_milestone_cnt)+SUM(milestone_on_time_cnt)+SUM(milestone_overdue_completed_cnt))::numeric*100,2) END AS "里程碑完成率" FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND ({{projectNo}} IS NULL OR {{projectNo}} = '' OR project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')

SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(due_cnt)+SUM(outside_completed_cnt))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(completed_total_cnt)::numeric/(SUM(due_cnt)+SUM(outside_completed_cnt))::numeric*100,2) END AS "完成率", CASE WHEN (SUM(incomplete_milestone_cnt)+SUM(milestone_on_time_cnt)+SUM(milestone_overdue_completed_cnt))=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(milestone_on_time_cnt)+SUM(milestone_overdue_completed_cnt))::numeric/(SUM(incomplete_milestone_cnt)+SUM(milestone_on_time_cnt)+SUM(milestone_overdue_completed_cnt))::numeric*100,2) END AS "里程碑完成率" FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND ({{projectNo}} IS NULL OR {{projectNo}} = '' OR project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%')

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(due_cnt)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((SUM(abnormal_pending_non_general_cnt)+SUM(overdue_incomplete_unchanged_non_general_cnt))::numeric/SUM(due_cnt)::numeric*100,2) END AS "异常率" FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND ({{deptId}} IS NULL OR {{deptId}} = '' OR project_no IN (SELECT DISTINCT project_no FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE dept = {{deptId}})) AND ({{projectNo}} IS NULL OR {{projectNo}} = '' OR project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND ({{riskLevel}} IS NULL OR {{riskLevel}} = '' OR project_no IN (SELECT DISTINCT project_no FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE risk_level = {{riskLevel}}))

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(incomplete_cnt)=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(incomplete_high_risk_cnt)::numeric/SUM(incomplete_cnt)::numeric*100,2) END AS "风险预警指数" FROM biz_dws_progress_monthly_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND ({{deptId}} IS NULL OR {{deptId}} = '' OR project_no IN (SELECT DISTINCT project_no FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE dept = {{deptId}})) AND ({{projectNo}} IS NULL OR {{projectNo}} = '' OR project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND ({{riskLevel}} IS NULL OR {{riskLevel}} = '' OR project_no IN (SELECT DISTINCT project_no FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE risk_level = {{riskLevel}}))

SELECT project_no AS "项目编号", subsystem AS "分系统", node_task AS "节点任务", node_type AS "节点类型", owner AS "负责人", dept AS "责任科室", completion_status AS "完成情况", risk_level AS "风险等级", plan_date AS "计划时间", actual_date AS "实际完成", delay_days AS "延期天数", incomplete_reason AS "未完成原因" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND ({{deptId}} IS NULL OR {{deptId}} = '' OR dept = {{deptId}}) AND ({{projectNo}} IS NULL OR {{projectNo}} = '' OR project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND ({{riskLevel}} IS NULL OR {{riskLevel}} = '' OR risk_level = {{riskLevel}}) ORDER BY delay_days DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT dept AS "责任科室", COUNT(*) AS "节点总数", SUM(CASE WHEN is_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "已完成", SUM(CASE WHEN is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "未完成" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND ({{deptId}} IS NULL OR {{deptId}} = '' OR dept = {{deptId}}) AND ({{projectNo}} IS NULL OR {{projectNo}} = '' OR project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND dept IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dept ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC

SELECT project_no AS "项目编号", subsystem AS "分系统", node_task AS "节点任务", node_type AS "节点类型", owner AS "负责人", dept AS "责任科室", completion_status AS "完成情况", risk_level AS "风险等级", plan_date AS "计划时间", actual_date AS "实际完成", delay_days AS "延期天数", incomplete_reason AS "未完成原因" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND ({{deptId}} IS NULL OR {{deptId}} = '' OR dept = {{deptId}}) AND ({{projectNo}} IS NULL OR {{projectNo}} = '' OR project_no ILIKE '%' || {{projectNo}} || '%') AND ({{riskLevel}} IS NULL OR {{riskLevel}} = '' OR risk_level = {{riskLevel}}) AND is_incomplete = true ORDER BY delay_days DESC NULLS LAST
